# Chapter I - Term Deposits {#c1}

## A. Minimum Tenor {#a}

1. The minimum tenor of a domestic term deposit shall be seven days.

2. Banks shall not pay interest on a term deposit that is withdrawn before the completion of the minimum tenor of seven days.

## B. Premature Withdrawal {#b}

3. A bank may levy a penalty on premature withdrawal of a term deposit, as set out in its Board-approved policy, subject to the ceiling in the table below.

| Deposit amount | Maximum penalty |
| --- | --- |
| Up to rupees fifteen lakh | One percent below the contracted rate |
| Above rupees fifteen lakh | As per the Board-approved policy, disclosed upfront |

# Chapter II - Savings Deposits {#c2}

## C. Interest Calculation {#c}

4. Interest on savings deposits shall be calculated on a daily product basis and credited at quarterly or shorter intervals.

5. Banks shall pay interest on the balance in the account of a deceased depositor at the savings rate from the date of death until the date of settlement of the claim.
